shellEnvDeclarations.description: Current loopback Harness ComfyUI CLI endpoint.
This variable contains the path to the Host Electron executable. Set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 when invoking the managed Harness ComfyUI CLI with this executable.
Canonical local URL of the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI serving this session.

bashSchema.name: bash
bashSchema.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap, and kills the command on expiry.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

{ printf 'session_id=%s\n' "$DSH_SESSION_ID"; printf 'cli=%s\n' "$DSH_HARNESS_COMFYUI_CLI"; printf 'node=%s\n' "$DSH_HARNESS_COMFYUI_NODE_EXECUTABLE"; printf 'api=%s\n' "$DSH_HARNESS_COMFYUI_CLI_API"; if [ -n "${DSH_HARNESS_COMFYUI_CLI_CAPABILITY:-}" ]; then printf 'capability_present=true\n'; else printf 'capability_present=false\n'; fi; } > '/private/var/folders/td/trvrwv_d2bxb0ns9qgpmmlqm0000gn/T/harness-run-ozkcyd/runtime/environment/workspace/probe-shell-environment.txt'

{"template_id":"29","instance_id":"2"}
JSON
probe_exit=$?
printf '%s\n' "$probe_exit" > '/private/var/folders/td/trvrwv_d2bxb0ns9qgpmmlqm0000gn/T/harness-run-ozkcyd/runtime/environment/workspace/probe-cli.exit'
cat '/private/var/folders/td/trvrwv_d2bxb0ns9qgpmmlqm0000gn/T/harness-run-ozkcyd/runtime/environment/workspace/probe-cli.stderr'
exit "$probe_exit"
